source_reference: Canonical Crypto policy Notion doc, section 'PAPER 전용 초기 비교 기준 (PROPOSED_PAPER_BASELINE, v1)' -- PAPER-only comparison baseline, explicitly not a live-capital trading limit ('이 숫자들은 PAPER 비교용이지 실거래 한도가 아니다'). RATIFIED overrides applied 2026-09-18 per CLAUDE_CIO_PAPER_EXECUTION_V1_BUILD_PLAN_20260915.md row C4 (sha256 11f3d3422378cc152ae2af555cfb62926e3fe6779f2de0125c1bd811ebf6412a) and USER_RATIFICATION_PAPER_MARKET_ALLOCATION_V2_20260913.json: (1) single_asset_paper_exposure_nav_fraction raised 0.02->0.05 ('종목 누적 <= NAV 5%...BTC/ETH도 5%'); (2) the old fixed max_concurrent_paper_positions=3 cap is superseded ('옛 코인 3종목 한도 대체') and removed -- NameRoom/liquidity room bind instead. NOT applied here (missing inputs, see code comment at _paper_risk): total_crypto_paper_exposure_nav_fraction is ratified as NAV0 x 0.15 x per-market state multiplier (RISK_ON 1.00/NEUTRAL 0.70/RISK_OFF 0.25/STRESS 0.00/UNKNOWN hold-up-to-0.50-no-new-buys per USER_RATIFICATION_PAPER_MARKET_ALLOCATION_V2_20260913.json), not a flat fraction -- this function has no crypto market-state input, so the field is left at the old, more conservative 0.05 rather than guessing a static number. A ratified 1%-of-30-day-average-traded-value per-name liquidity cap (build plan C4) also has no field here because no 30-day ADV input reaches this function.
